layman_headline: Time to cash in on Solana's rally before the market gets too greedy.
layman_explanation: The entire crypto market just had an explosive week — Bitcoin surged 22% to near $80K, and most altcoins rallied even harder. Our Solana position is up 10.3% and very close to our profit target of $100. Meanwhile, market sentiment has jumped to 'Greed' at 73, which historically is when rallies start losing steam. All the swing trade candidates have already run 25-65% in a week, making new entries very risky right now.
layman_action: Take profits on the Solana position now at ~$96. Keep the XRP position open as it still has room to its target but watch the $1.30 stop-loss closely. Wait for a market pullback before entering any new trades.
expert_reasoning: The market has experienced a sharp broad-based rally with BTC +22%, ETH +30%, XRP +47%, SOL +27% in just one week. Fear & Greed at 73 and rising fast (from 61.6 weekly average) signals potential short-term exhaustion. SOL at $96.29 is within striking distance of the $100 exit target set at entry, and the risk/reward of holding for another 4% upside versus a potential 10-15% correction is unfavorable. All swing candidates show negative composite scores due to overextension. XRP remains underwater at -5.1% but is well above its $1.30 stop-loss and still has 25% upside to its $1.85 target — the 47.5% weekly move suggests strong momentum that could carry further despite the near-term pullback risk. No new entries are justified when every candidate has already run 25%+ in a week.
risk_factors: Market-wide exhaustion after 20-50% weekly moves could trigger sharp pullback, dragging XRP below stop-loss
BTC dominance at 59.1% is high — if BTC corrects, alts will likely fall harder
Fear & Greed jumping from 62 to 73 in one week often precedes short-term reversals
watch_list: BTC price action around $80K — a rejection here could trigger a broad market pullback
XRP holding above $1.40 support — if it breaks, consider tightening stop-loss from $1.30
Fear & Greed index — if it crosses 80, expect increased volatility and correction risk
market_context: The crypto market is in a powerful but potentially overextended rally, with BTC near $80K and most alts up 20-50% in a single week. Sentiment has shifted rapidly to Greed, and while momentum is strong, the risk of a sharp pullback is elevated.
context_banner: Market-wide rally approaching exhaustion — lock in gains on winners and wait for pullback before new entries.

key_signals.description: Fear & Greed jumped to 73 (Greed) from a weekly average of 61.6, signaling rapidly heating sentiment that often precedes corrections.
BTC volume at $52B and broad market participation confirm a genuine breakout, but the magnitude (22% BTC weekly move) suggests the easy gains are done.
Bitcoin nearing $80K with analysts warning the next pullback will be key — supports profit-taking thesis on extended positions.
Over $220M in short liquidations in 24 hours indicates most bears have been squeezed out, reducing fuel for further upside.
All swing candidates flagged as overextended with negative 7-day price action scores — no favorable entry setups available this cycle.
